steps.title: Start with an ADR
steps.narrative: An architect publishes an ADR describing a hard requirement. Pathfinder will turn prose into reviewable obligation candidates without calling an LLM on the assess path.
steps.technical: ADR Markdown must include an H1 title. ingest-adrs builds a content-addressed index; extract later cites source_path + line ranges + SHA-256.

steps.title: Extract + score confidence
steps.narrative: Deterministic extractors find obligation-like statements and assign high/medium/low confidence. Only the low band is eligible for batch LLM assist.
steps.technical: Confidence combines modality strength, pattern_hint match, and citation quality. Escalation reasons are recorded on the candidate for review UX.

steps.title: Batch LLM assist
steps.narrative: When confidence is low, assist drafts a normalized statement and suggested pattern. Offline mode uses fixtures so CI stays green without secrets.
steps.technical: assist-obligations verifies the source quote against file bytes/SHA. Proposals set executable=false and approval_status=pending_review. Live mode accumulates prompt/completion tokens and estimated_cost_usd.

steps.title: Human accept / reject
steps.narrative: A reviewer accepts or rejects the proposal into the append-only review registry. Accept rate becomes a workshop KPI.
steps.technical: accept-assist-proposal → ProposalToReview → RecordReview. Citation drift between proposal and candidate fails closed.

steps.title: Deterministic assess gate
steps.narrative: PR/issue assessment evaluates requirements with analyzer evidence and binding coverage — still zero runtime LLM calls.
steps.technical: workshop-emit --enforce-assess-llm fails if runtime_llm_calls != 0 on assess workflows.

steps.title: Publish to command center
steps.narrative: Artifacts land on the workshop-data branch and the Pages SPA renders drilldowns, ADR dig-ins, cost, and this Sample journey.
steps.technical: workshop-publish builds the Vite app and deploys with actions/deploy-pages. Fixtures ship for local preview when live data is thin.
callouts: Internal tool — full visibility by design
